d.s: Sikalastic-777 is a high performance, hand-applied, low VOC, moisture-curing single component elastomeric polyurethane membrane with excellent root-resistance properties.
a: Low VOC, complies with Green Star requirements
High elongation, Class III membrane >300% according to AS/NZ4858
us: Sikalastic-777 is designed for the following waterproofing applications:

sec.t: AS/NZS 4654.1:2012- Waterproofing membranes for external above-ground
From date of production if stored properly in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5°C and +30°C.

In normal conditions, Sikalastic-777 can be recoated with another layer of Sikalastic-777 after one night and within 2 days. In case of rain or if the recoating interval was exceeded, light abrasion and reactivate Sikalastic-777 with Sika Thinner C or for the best results remove the existing coating back to substrate and re-apply.
Sikalastic-777 can be subject to light foot traffic after 24 hours.

Surface must be clean, sound, smooth and dust-free as well as oil-free. In the case of a high porosity substrate, it is recommended to use an epoxy primer. Please see 'priming' section below for further information.
Reusable tools should be cleaned carefully with Sika Thinner C before curing.

layer_thickness.label: Dry film thickness
layer_thickness.text: Vertical applications: 2 coats of a minimum of 0.670 litres (670 micron) /m2 each are required to achieve a 1 mm dry film thickness. Floor applications: 2 coats of a minimum of 0.8 litre (800 micron) /m2 each are required to achieve a 1.2 mm dry film thickness. Minimum 1-1.2mm DFT recommended on all applications.

cure_times.label: Drying time
cure_times.text: Sikalastic®-777 can be subject to light foot traffic after 24 hours.

recoat_times.label: Waiting time to overcoating
recoat_times.text: In normal conditions, Sikalastic®-777 can be recoated with another layer of Sikalastic®-777 after one night and within 2 days

cp.text: Do not install Sikalastic®-777 without the use of a primer

storage.label: Conditions for safe storage
storage.text: Store in original container. Keep in a well-ventilated place. Containers which are opened must be carefully resealed and kept upright to prevent leakage. Observe label precautions. Store in accordance with local regulations.

handling.label: Advice on protection against fire and explosion
handling.text: Normal measures for preventive fire protection.

handling.label: Advice on safe handling
handling.text: Avoid exceeding the given occupational exposure limits (see section 8). Do not get in eyes, on skin, or on clothing. For personal protection see section 8. Smoking, eating and drinking should be prohibited in the application area. Provide sufficient air exchange and/or exhaust in work rooms. Follow standard hygiene measures when handling chemical products

handling.label: Hygiene measures
handling.text: Handle in accordance with good industrial hygiene and safety practice. When using do not eat or drink. When using do not smoke. Wash hands before breaks and at the end of workday.

respiratory.label: Respiratory protection
respiratory.text: In case of inadequate ventilation wear respiratory protection. Respirator selection must be based on known or anticipated exposure levels, the hazards of the product and the safe working limits of the selected respirator.

hands.label: Hand protection
hands.text: Chemical-resistant, impervious gloves complying with an approved standard should be worn at all times when handling chemical products if a risk assessment indicates this is necessary. Follow AS/NZS 1337.1 Recommended: Butyl rubber/nitrile rubber gloves. Contaminated gloves should be removed.

skin_body.label: Skin and body protection
skin_body.text: Protective clothing (e.g. safety shoes, long-sleeved working clothing, long trousers) Follow AS 2210:3 Protective clothing needs to be made of cotton.

engineering_controls.label: Appropriate engineering controls
engineering_controls.text: Use adequate ventilation and/or engineering controls to prevent exposure to vapours.
